```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Angular Hellinger Compositional Normalization
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Input:
#   X: matrix or data.frame
#      rows = samples, columns = taxa/features/components
#
# Output:
#   transformed matrix with same dimension as X
#
# Formula:
#   pi_i = X_i / sum_j X_ij
#   c(pi_i) = (1 / sqrt(k)) * sum_j sqrt(pi_ij)
#   s(pi_i) = sqrt(1 - c(pi_i)^2)
#   T(pi_i) = asin(s(pi_i)) / s(pi_i) *
#             (sqrt(pi_i) - c(pi_i) * sqrt(pi_0))
#
# where sqrt(pi_0) = (1/sqrt(k), ..., 1/sqrt(k)).
# ------------------------------------------------------------

angular_hellinger_normalization <- function(X) {
  
  # Convert to matrix
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  
  # Check input
  if (!is.numeric(X)) {
    stop("X must be numeric.")
  }
  
  if (any(X < 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    stop("X must contain non-negative values only.")
  }
  
  if (anyNA(X)) {
    stop("X contains NA values. Please handle missing values first.")
  }
  
  # Number of components
  k <- ncol(X)
  
  if (k < 2) {
    stop("X must contain at least two components.")
  }
  
  # Row sums
  rs <- rowSums(X)
  
  if (any(rs <= 0)) {
    stop("Each row must have positive total abundance.")
  }
  
  # Convert count/abundance data to compositional data
  Pi <- sweep(X, 1, rs, FUN = "/")
  
  # Square-root composition
  sqrt_Pi <- sqrt(Pi)
  
  # Uniform direction in square-root space
  sqrt_pi0 <- rep(1 / sqrt(k), k)
  
  # c(pi): cosine-type Hellinger similarity to the uniform composition
  c_pi <- as.vector(sqrt_Pi %*% sqrt_pi0)
  
  # Numerical protection: theoretically c(pi) is in [0, 1]
  c_pi <- pmin(pmax(c_pi, 0), 1)
  
  # s(pi) = sqrt(1 - c(pi)^2)
  s_pi <- sqrt(1 - c_pi^2)
  
  # Scaling factor
  scale_factor <- asin(s_pi) / s_pi
  
  # Handle the exact uniform-composition case where s(pi) = 0
  scale_factor[s_pi == 0] <- 1
  
  # Centered square-root composition
  centered <- sqrt_Pi - outer(c_pi, sqrt_pi0)
  
  # Final transformation
  T <- centered * scale_factor
  
  # Keep row and column names
  rownames(T) <- rownames(X)
  colnames(T) <- colnames(X)
  
  return(T)
}
```



# check simulation result
```{r}
result <- read.csv("replicate_results_AHC_ALR_CLR_ILR_100rep.csv")
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)

alpha_level <- 0.05
setting_vars <- c("alpha", "beta0", "beta", "q")

## ============================================================
## 1. Basic checks
## ============================================================

required_cols <- c(
  "rep_id", "transformation", "power", "fdr",
  "TP", "FP", "FN", "rejections",
  setting_vars
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(result))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The following required columns are missing from result: ",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

result <- result %>%
  mutate(
    transformation = factor(
      transformation,
      levels = c("AHC", "ALR", "CLR", "ILR")
    )
  )

cat("\nNumber of rows:\n")
print(nrow(result))

cat("\nNumber of replications per setting/method:\n")
print(
  result %>%
    count(alpha, beta0, beta, q, transformation, name = "n_reps") %>%
    arrange(alpha, beta0, beta, q, transformation)
)


## ============================================================
## 2. Summarize power/FDR under each setting and method
## ============================================================

summary_setting_method <- result %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(setting_vars)), transformation) %>%
  summarize(
    n_reps = n(),
    mean_power = mean(power, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_power = sd(power, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_fdr = mean(fdr, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_fdr = sd(fdr, na.rm = TRUE),
    fdr_na_rate = mean(is.na(fdr)),
    mean_TP = mean(TP, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_FP = mean(FP, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_FN = mean(FN, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_rejections = mean(rejections, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_fdr = ifelse(is.nan(mean_fdr), NA_real_, mean_fdr),
    sd_fdr = ifelse(is.nan(sd_fdr), NA_real_, sd_fdr),
    fdr_for_rule = ifelse(is.na(mean_fdr), 0, mean_fdr),
    fdr_controlled = fdr_for_rule <= alpha_level
  )

cat("\nSummary by setting and method:\n")
print(summary_setting_method, n = 50)


## ============================================================
## 3. Find best method under each setting
## ============================================================

## Best by power only
best_by_power <- summary_setting_method %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(setting_vars))) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_power), fdr_for_rule, transformation, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    across(all_of(setting_vars)),
    best_power_method = as.character(transformation),
    best_power = mean_power,
    best_power_fdr = mean_fdr
  )

## Best by FDR only
best_by_fdr <- summary_setting_method %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(setting_vars))) %>%
  arrange(fdr_for_rule, desc(mean_power), transformation, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    across(all_of(setting_vars)),
    best_fdr_method = as.character(transformation),
    best_fdr = mean_fdr,
    best_fdr_power = mean_power
  )

## Recommended best method:
## First require mean FDR <= 0.05, then choose largest power.
## If several methods control FDR, this chooses the highest-power one.
best_overall <- summary_setting_method %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(setting_vars))) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(fdr_controlled),
    desc(mean_power),
    fdr_for_rule,
    transformation,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    across(all_of(setting_vars)),
    best_overall_method = as.character(transformation),
    best_overall_power = mean_power,
    best_overall_fdr = mean_fdr,
    best_overall_fdr_controlled = fdr_controlled
  )

best_by_setting <- best_by_power %>%
  left_join(best_by_fdr, by = setting_vars) %>%
  left_join(best_overall, by = setting_vars) %>%
  arrange(alpha, beta0, beta, q)

cat("\nBest method under each setting:\n")
print(best_by_setting, n = 100)


## If you want to print all settings, use this:
## print(best_by_setting, n = Inf)


## ============================================================
## 4. Winner frequency table
## ============================================================

cat("\nWinner count by best-power criterion:\n")
print(
  best_by_setting %>%
    count(best_power_method, name = "n_settings") %>%
    mutate(prop_settings = n_settings / sum(n_settings)) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_settings))
)

cat("\nWinner count by best-FDR criterion:\n")
print(
  best_by_setting %>%
    count(best_fdr_method, name = "n_settings") %>%
    mutate(prop_settings = n_settings / sum(n_settings)) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_settings))
)

cat("\nWinner count by recommended criterion: FDR control first, then power:\n")
print(
  best_by_setting %>%
    count(best_overall_method, name = "n_settings") %>%
    mutate(prop_settings = n_settings / sum(n_settings)) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_settings))
)


## ============================================================
## 5. Overall method performance across all settings
## ============================================================

overall_method_summary <- summary_setting_method %>%
  group_by(transformation) %>%
  summarize(
    avg_power = mean(mean_power, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_setting_power = sd(mean_power, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_fdr = mean(mean_fdr, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_setting_fdr = sd(mean_fdr, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_settings_fdr_controlled = mean(fdr_controlled, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_rejections = mean(mean_rejections, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_power))

cat("\nOverall method summary across all settings:\n")
print(overall_method_summary)


## ============================================================
## 6. Compare AHC against the best competing method
## ============================================================

ahc_vs_others <- summary_setting_method %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(setting_vars))) %>%
  summarize(
    AHC_power = mean_power[transformation == "AHC"],
    AHC_fdr = mean_fdr[transformation == "AHC"],
    best_other_power = max(mean_power[transformation != "AHC"], na.rm = TRUE),
    best_other_method = as.character(
      transformation[transformation != "AHC"][
        which.max(mean_power[transformation != "AHC"])
      ]
    ),
    best_other_fdr = mean_fdr[transformation == best_other_method],
    AHC_minus_best_other_power = AHC_power - best_other_power,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(AHC_minus_best_other_power))

cat("\nSettings where AHC has the largest power advantage over other methods:\n")
print(head(ahc_vs_others, 20))

cat("\nSettings where AHC has the largest power disadvantage relative to other methods:\n")
print(tail(ahc_vs_others, 20))

cat("\nHow often AHC beats all other methods by power:\n")
print(
  ahc_vs_others %>%
    summarize(
      n_settings = n(),
      n_AHC_best_power = sum(AHC_minus_best_other_power > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      prop_AHC_best_power = mean(AHC_minus_best_other_power > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_AHC_power_advantage = mean(AHC_minus_best_other_power, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
)


## ============================================================
## 7. Visualization 1: Average power vs q
## ============================================================

plot_power_q <- summary_setting_method %>%
  group_by(q, transformation) %>%
  summarize(
    avg_power = mean(mean_power, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = q, y = avg_power, group = transformation, color = transformation)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Power Across Zero-Inflation Level q",
    x = "Zero-inflation probability q",
    y = "Average power",
    color = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

print(plot_power_q)


## ============================================================
## 8. Visualization 2: Average FDR vs q
## ============================================================

plot_fdr_q <- summary_setting_method %>%
  group_by(q, transformation) %>%
  summarize(
    avg_fdr = mean(mean_fdr, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = q, y = avg_fdr, group = transformation, color = transformation)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = alpha_level, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Average FDR Across Zero-Inflation Level q",
    x = "Zero-inflation probability q",
    y = "Average FDR",
    color = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

print(plot_fdr_q)


## ============================================================
## 9. Visualization 3: Average power vs beta
## ============================================================

plot_power_beta <- summary_setting_method %>%
  group_by(beta, transformation) %>%
  summarize(
    avg_power = mean(mean_power, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = beta, y = avg_power, group = transformation, color = transformation)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Power Across Effect Size beta",
    x = "Effect size beta",
    y = "Average power",
    color = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

print(plot_power_beta)


## ============================================================
## 10. Visualization 4: Power-FDR tradeoff
## ============================================================

plot_power_fdr <- summary_setting_method %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_fdr, y = mean_power, color = transformation)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = alpha_level, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Power-FDR Tradeoff Across All Simulation Settings",
    x = "Mean FDR",
    y = "Mean power",
    color = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

print(plot_power_fdr)


## ============================================================
## 11. Visualization 5: Recommended winner by beta and q
## ============================================================

winner_beta_q <- best_by_setting %>%
  count(beta, q, best_overall_method, name = "n_wins") %>%
  group_by(beta, q) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_wins), best_overall_method, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

plot_winner_beta_q <- winner_beta_q %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(q), y = factor(beta), fill = best_overall_method)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = best_overall_method), size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Most Frequent Recommended Winner by beta and q",
    subtitle = "Recommended criterion: FDR controlled first, then largest power",
    x = "q",
    y = "beta",
    fill = "Winner"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

print(plot_winner_beta_q)


## ============================================================
## 12. Visualization 6: AHC power advantage over best competitor
## ============================================================

plot_ahc_advantage <- ahc_vs_others %>%
  group_by(beta, q) %>%
  summarize(
    avg_AHC_minus_best_other_power =
      mean(AHC_minus_best_other_power, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = factor(q),
    y = factor(beta),
    fill = avg_AHC_minus_best_other_power
  )) +

    aes(label = round(avg_AHC_minus_best_other_power, 3)),
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Average AHC Power Advantage Over Best Competing Method",
    x = "q",
    y = "beta",
    fill = "AHC - best other"
  ) +

print(plot_ahc_advantage)


## ============================================================
## 13. Optional: simple pattern analysis for when AHC wins
## ============================================================

ahc_win_pattern <- best_by_setting %>%
  mutate(AHC_win = best_overall_method == "AHC") %>%
  group_by(AHC_win) %>%

    n_settings = n(),
    mean_alpha = mean(alpha),
    mean_beta0 = mean(beta0),

cat("\nAverage settings where AHC wins vs does not win:\n")
print(ahc_win_pattern)

    )
)

cat("\nAHC win rate by beta:\n")
print(

)
```

# GUniFrac simulation
```{r}
result <- read.csv("replicate_results_AHC_RAHC_ALR_reference_choices_CLR_ILR_MSeqU_100rep_corrected.csv")
```

## 1

```{r}
###############################################################################
## Differential abundance: figures + COMPACT tables for the manuscript
##
## Reads the full replicate-level result (one row per rep x method x setting).
## Produces:
##   (A) power  vs depth, faceted signal-mode x depth-confounding   [MAIN]
##   (B) type-I vs depth, same layout    [MAIN companion - explains the drop]
##   (C) power-vs-type1 scatter, your style, cleaned     [SUPPLEMENT]
##   Tables: compact marginal summary + driver lm (NOT a 100s-row table)
###############################################################################
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse); library(broom)
})


out <- "analysis_out"; dir.create(out, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

## ---- type I error per row, and tidy factors ----
result <- result %>%
  mutate(n_signal_tested = TP + FN,
         n_null_tested  = n_tested - n_signal_tested,
         type1_error    = ifelse(n_null_tested > 0, FP / n_null_tested, NA_real_),
         diff_otu_mode  = factor(diff_otu_mode, c("rare","mix","abundant")),
         depth_mu       = as.numeric(depth_mu))

## ---- MAIN methods (one min-var reference each; all references -> supplement) ----
main_methods <- c("AHC","RAHC_minvar_ref","ALR_minvar_ref","CLR","ILR")
relab <- c(AHC="AHC", RAHC_minvar_ref="RAHC (min-var)", ALR_minvar_ref="ALR (min-var)",
           CLR="CLR", ILR="ILR")
wong  <- c(AHC="#0072B2", `RAHC (min-var)`="#56B4E9", `ALR (min-var)`="#D55E00",
           CLR="#009E73", ILR="#CC79A7")

dm <- result %>% filter(transformation %in% main_methods) %>%
  mutate(method = factor(relab[transformation], levels = names(wong)))

theme_pub <- theme_bw(base_size = 9, base_family = "serif") +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = .25, colour = "grey90"),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))

agg <- dm %>%
  group_by(diff_otu_mode, depth_mu, depth_conf_factor, method) %>%
  summarise(power = mean(power, na.rm = TRUE),
            type1 = mean(type1_error, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

## ---------- FIGURE A: power vs depth ----------
pA <- ggplot(agg, aes(depth_mu, power, colour = method)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = .6) + geom_point(size = 1.2) +
  scale_x_log10() + scale_colour_manual(values = wong, name = NULL) +
  facet_grid(depth_conf_factor ~ diff_otu_mode,
             labeller = labeller(depth_conf_factor = function(z) paste0("depth conf = ", z))) +
  labs(x = expression("mean sequencing depth "*mu), y = "power",
       title = "Power vs depth, by signal location and depth confounding") +
  ylim(0,1) + theme_pub
ggsave(file.path(out,"figDA_power_depth.pdf"), pA, width=7.2, height=4.4, device=cairo_pdf)

## ---------- FIGURE B: type I error vs depth (explains the apparent drop) ----------
pB <- ggplot(agg, aes(depth_mu, type1, colour = method)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = .05, linetype = 2, linewidth = .4) +
  geom_line(linewidth = .6) + geom_point(size = 1.2) +
  scale_x_log10() + scale_colour_manual(values = wong, name = NULL) +
  facet_grid(depth_conf_factor ~ diff_otu_mode,
             labeller = labeller(depth_conf_factor = function(z) paste0("depth conf = ", z))) +
  labs(x = expression("mean sequencing depth "*mu), y = "type I error",
       title = "Type I error vs depth (read alongside power)") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.35)) + theme_pub
ggsave(file.path(out,"figDA_type1_depth.pdf"), pB, width=7.2, height=4.4, device=cairo_pdf)

## ---------- FIGURE C (SUPPLEMENT): your power-vs-type1 scatter, cleaned ----------
sett_vars <- c("diff_otu_direct","diff_otu_mode","depth_mu","depth_theta",
               "covariate_eff_sd","confounder_eff_sd","depth_conf_factor")
sett <- dm %>% group_by(across(all_of(sett_vars)), method) %>%
  summarise(mean_power = mean(power, na.rm=TRUE),
            mean_type1 = mean(type1_error, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")
pC <- ggplot(sett, aes(mean_type1, mean_power, colour = log10(depth_mu))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = .05, linetype = 2, linewidth = .4, colour="grey35") +
  geom_point(size = .8, alpha = .5) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(option="C", name=expression(log[10]~mu)) +
  facet_grid(diff_otu_mode ~ method) +
  labs(x="mean type I error", y="mean power",
       title="Power--type I error across settings (supplement)") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0,0.2), ylim=c(0,1)) + theme_pub
ggsave(file.path(out,"figDA_scatter_supp.pdf"), pC, width=8.5, height=5.0, device=cairo_pdf)

###############################################################################
## COMPACT TABLE 1 (manuscript-sized): marginal means by ONE factor at a time.
## Rows = method; blocks = signal location and depth band. ~ a dozen rows.
###############################################################################
result <- result %>%
  mutate(depth_band = cut(depth_mu, c(0,100,1000,Inf),
                          labels=c("low(<=100)","mid(<=1e3)","high(>1e3)")))
t_mode <- dm %>% group_by(method, diff_otu_mode) %>%
  summarise(power=mean(power,na.rm=TRUE), type1=mean(type1_error,na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=diff_otu_mode, values_from=c(power,type1))
readr::write_csv(t_mode, file.path(out,"tableDA_by_signal_location.csv"))

###############################################################################
## COMPACT TABLE 2: driver regression (one small coefficient table, not 100s rows)
###############################################################################
drivers <- sett %>% mutate(log10_depth = log10(depth_mu))
fit_pw <- lm(mean_power ~ method + diff_otu_direct + diff_otu_mode + log10_depth +
               depth_theta + covariate_eff_sd + confounder_eff_sd + depth_conf_factor,
             data = drivers)
fit_t1 <- lm(mean_type1 ~ method + diff_otu_direct + diff_otu_mode + log10_depth +
               depth_theta + covariate_eff_sd + confounder_eff_sd + depth_conf_factor,
             data = drivers)
readr::write_csv(tidy(fit_pw), file.path(out,"tableDA_power_drivers.csv"))
readr::write_csv(tidy(fit_t1), file.path(out,"tableDA_type1_drivers.csv"))

cat("Done. See", out, "\n")
```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)

## ============================================================
## 1. Use your existing result object
## ============================================================

data <- result

## ============================================================
## 2. Basic checks
## ============================================================

required_cols <- c(
  "transformation", "power", "TP", "FP", "FN",
  "rejections", "n_tested"
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(data))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

## ============================================================
## 3. Prepare method label
## If your ALR choices are already in transformation, this keeps them.
## ============================================================

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    method = as.character(transformation),
    
    ## Number of true signal features tested
    n_signal_tested = TP + FN,
    
    ## Number of null features tested
    n_null_tested = n_tested - n_signal_tested,
    
    ## Type I error = FP / number of null features tested
    type1_error = ifelse(n_null_tested > 0, FP / n_null_tested, NA_real_)
  )

## ============================================================
## 4. Simple mean/SD summary by method
## ============================================================

simple_summary <- data %>%
  group_by(method) %>%
  summarize(
    n_rows = n(),
    
    mean_power = mean(power, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_power = sd(power, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    mean_type1_error = mean(type1_error, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_type1_error = sd(type1_error, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    mean_rejections = mean(rejections, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_rejections = sd(rejections, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    mean_TP = mean(TP, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_FP = mean(FP, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_FN = mean(FN, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_power))

print(simple_summary, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
## ============================================================
## Power vs type I error tradeoff -- THREE matched figures
##
##   Figure 1 : main methods   AHC, RAHC (Min-Var), ALR (Min-Var), CLR, ILR
##   Figure 2 : ALR  reference choices  (Non-diff, Random, Signal, Last, Min-Var)
##   Figure 3 : RAHC reference choices  (Non-diff, Random, Signal, Last, Min-Var)
##
## All three share the SAME design as your current figure:
##   2 rows (Balanced / Unbalanced) x 5 method columns,
##   colour = sequencing depth (DISCRETE, NO log transform),
##   shape  = differential OTU mode (Rare/Mix/Abundant),
##   dashed vertical line at type I error = 0.05.
##
## Depth: your grid has 14 levels; for legibility we DISPLAY only a
##   representative subset (default 5, spanning shallow->deep). All settings
##   are still computed; we just thin the plotted depths. Set
##   DEPTHS_TO_SHOW <- NULL to show all levels.
##
## Input: `setting_summary` from your existing prep code, with columns
##   method, diff_otu_direct, diff_otu_mode, depth_mu,
##   mean_power, mean_type1_error
## ============================================================

library(tidyverse)

fig_dir <- file.path(getwd(), "figures")
dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Choose which sequencing depths to DISPLAY (subset of the 14).
## Pick `n_show` levels spread evenly (on log spacing) across the range.
## ------------------------------------------------------------
pick_depths <- function(all_depths, n_show = 5) {
  d <- sort(unique(all_depths))
  if (is.null(n_show) || n_show >= length(d)) return(d)
  idx <- round(seq(1, length(d), length.out = n_show))
  unique(d[idx])
}
## You can also hard-set this, e.g. DEPTHS_TO_SHOW <- c(1000, 3332, 8219, 20272, 50000)
DEPTHS_TO_SHOW <- pick_depths(setting_summary$depth_mu, n_show = 5)
cat("Displaying sequencing depths:\n"); print(DEPTHS_TO_SHOW)

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Pretty display labels for method facet strips
## ------------------------------------------------------------
pretty_method <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    stringr::str_replace("_minvar_ref",  " (Min-Var)") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("_nondiff_ref", " (Non-diff)") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("_random_ref",  " (Random)") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("_signal_ref",  " (Signal)") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("_last_ref",    " (Last)")
}

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Shared plotting function (identical look for all three figures)
## ------------------------------------------------------------
make_tradeoff_plot <- function(plot_data, method_order, plot_title,
                               depths_to_show = DEPTHS_TO_SHOW,
                               x_upper = NULL, y_upper = NULL) {

  ## keep only displayed depths
  if (!is.null(depths_to_show)) {
    plot_data <- dplyr::filter(plot_data, depth_mu %in% depths_to_show)
  }

  depth_levels  <- sort(unique(plot_data$depth_mu))
  ## blue (shallow) -> red (deep); discrete, ordered, NO log
  depth_palette <- colorRampPalette(
    c("#2C5F9E", "#7FB8DA", "#F4A24C", "#C8341F"))(length(depth_levels))
  names(depth_palette) <- as.character(depth_levels)

  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    mutate(
      method = factor(pretty_method(as.character(method)),
                      levels = pretty_method(method_order)),
      diff_otu_direct = factor(stringr::str_to_title(as.character(diff_otu_direct)),
                               levels = c("Balanced", "Unbalanced")),
      diff_otu_mode = factor(as.character(diff_otu_mode),
                             levels = c("rare", "mix", "abundant"),
                             labels = c("Rare", "Mix", "Abundant")),
      depth_f = factor(as.character(depth_mu), levels = as.character(depth_levels))
    )

  if (is.null(x_upper)) {
    xm <- max(plot_data$mean_type1_error, na.rm = TRUE)
    x_upper <- if (!is.finite(xm)) 0.08 else max(0.08, 1.10 * xm)
  }
  if (is.null(y_upper)) {
    ym <- max(plot_data$mean_power, na.rm = TRUE)
    y_upper <- if (!is.finite(ym)) 0.45 else max(0.42, 1.08 * ym)
  }

  ggplot(plot_data,
         aes(x = mean_type1_error, y = mean_power,
             colour = depth_f, shape = diff_otu_mode)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0.05, linetype = "dashed",
               linewidth = 0.7, colour = "grey55") +
    geom_point(size = 2.6, alpha = 0.80, stroke = 0.4) +
    facet_grid(diff_otu_direct ~ method,
               labeller = labeller(method = label_wrap_gen(width = 14))) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, x_upper), ylim = c(0, y_upper)) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(Rare = 16, Mix = 17, Abundant = 15), drop = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = depth_palette) +
    guides(
      colour = guide_legend(title = "Sequencing depth",
                            override.aes = list(shape = 16, size = 3.2), order = 1),
      shape  = guide_legend(title = "Differential OTU mode",
                            override.aes = list(size = 3.2, colour = "grey25"), order = 2)
    ) +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = "Mean type I error", y = "Mean power") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.2, colour = "grey92"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = NA),
      strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9.5),
      legend.position  = "right",
      legend.title     = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 9.5),
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      axis.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text        = element_text(colour = "black"),
      panel.spacing    = unit(5, "pt")
    )
}

save_fig <- function(p, stem) {
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(stem, ".pdf")), p,
         width = 12.5, height = 5.8, device = cairo_pdf)
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(stem, ".png")), p,
         width = 12.5, height = 5.8, dpi = 600)
}

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Method groupings (edit if your label strings differ)
## ------------------------------------------------------------
all_methods <- unique(as.character(setting_summary$method))

main_methods <- c("AHC", "RAHC_minvar_ref", "ALR_minvar_ref", "CLR", "ILR")
main_methods <- main_methods[main_methods %in% all_methods]

alr_order <- c("ALR_nondiff_ref","ALR_random_ref","ALR_signal_ref",
               "ALR_last_ref","ALR_minvar_ref")
alr_order <- alr_order[alr_order %in% all_methods]

rahc_order <- c("RAHC_nondiff_ref","RAHC_random_ref","RAHC_signal_ref",
                "RAHC_last_ref","RAHC_minvar_ref")
rahc_order <- rahc_order[rahc_order %in% all_methods]

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## FIGURE 1 : main methods
## ------------------------------------------------------------
p1 <- setting_summary %>%
  filter(as.character(method) %in% main_methods) %>%
  mutate(method = factor(as.character(method), levels = main_methods)) %>%
  make_tradeoff_plot(main_methods,
    "Power\u2013type I error tradeoff: AHC vs logratio transformations")
print(p1); save_fig(p1, "figure1_main_methods_tradeoff")

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## FIGURE 2 : ALR reference choices
## ------------------------------------------------------------
p2 <- setting_summary %>%
  filter(as.character(method) %in% alr_order) %>%
  mutate(method = factor(as.character(method), levels = alr_order)) %>%
  make_tradeoff_plot(alr_order,
    "Power\u2013type I error tradeoff: ALR reference choices")
print(p2); save_fig(p2, "figure2_alr_reference_tradeoff")

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## FIGURE 3 : RAHC reference choices
## ------------------------------------------------------------
p3 <- setting_summary %>%
  filter(as.character(method) %in% rahc_order) %>%
  mutate(method = factor(as.character(method), levels = rahc_order)) %>%
  make_tradeoff_plot(rahc_order,
    "Power\u2013type I error tradeoff: RAHC reference choices")
print(p3); save_fig(p3, "figure3_rahc_reference_tradeoff")
```
